text:
sam: Staging smoke failed: cosign verify errors + vuln scan flagged libc. Looks like signed base image failing verification in runtime. We need RBAC + KMS check.
rachel: can you paste the cosign debug?
sam: log snippet: `cosign: error: permission denied fetching public key from kms://projects/infra-keys/...` and vuln: `glibc CVE-20ZZ-1234 recommended bump`.
lee: likely RBAC from yesterday's scoping PR. Paging ops.
ops-oncall: build-bot: canary failed with image verify error. See /var/log/containers/verify.log.
rachel: I'll check KMS key policy now and share membership.
sam: quick mitigation thought: ops can add a 24h temporary IAM binding to the key for svc-image-signer in the target project or add a staging-only admission exception for that digest. Prefer minimal blast.
lee: agree, add binding is smallest blast. Add justification for audit.
ops-oncall: applying binding: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/shared-build/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/signer --member=serviceAccount:svc-image-signer@redwood --role=roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` will annotate INC-3201 and set expiry via ticket.
rachel: binding in place, re-run cosign verify...
sam: verify passed for sha256:beefcafe. Re-queued pipeline.
build-bot: canary re-run: PASS (verify + smoke).
lee: postmortem items: 1) why RBAC scoping PR removed cross-project binding without a map, 2) add a PR check to flag signer principals referencing keys in other projects, 3) annotate images at build-time with kms-key path. I'll pick up 1 & 3.
sam: I'll collect Cloud Audit logs (KMS AsymmetricSign + IAMPolicyChange) and attach to INC-3201. Closing once postmortem PRs land. :+1:
